title: The dashboard in a parent's pocket
subtitle: Pair a parent's {{device}} once, then open the family dashboard from anywhere, with no VPN.

steps.say: This time the {{device}} belongs to Jordan, a parent.
On the dashboard at home, Jordan opened Devices → Admin devices and chose Pair an admin device.

say.default: A phone can scan the QR code. Here, Jordan pastes the pairing link instead.
say.macos: On a Mac, Jordan copies the pairing link from the dashboard and pastes it here.
say.windows: On a PC, Jordan copies the pairing link from the dashboard and pastes it here.

steps.say: The {{device}} is paired. The dashboard opens through the home gateway, with no VPN to install.
Riley's tablet just asked for 15 more minutes. Jordan answers from wherever they are.
Approved. It's the same dashboard as at home, just reached from away.

say.default: Next time, Jordan opens it straight from here.
say.android: Next time, Jordan just opens the app and lands on the dashboard.

steps.say: To stop using the {{device}}, Jordan unpairs it here. If it's ever lost, Jordan removes it from Devices → Admin devices at home, and it stops working at once.
